welcome: QuestTogether's controls now match Blizzard's current interface more closely.

sections.title: Blizzard-style controls
items: Settings sliders now have arrow buttons for fine adjustments and show their value beside the track.
Checkboxes, color swatches, scrollbars, and standard buttons now follow Blizzard's current appearance.
Party Quest Log and debug searches now include a search icon and a clear button.

sections.title: Scrolling improvements
items: Updated scrolling in settings, Party Quest Log, patch notes, and the debug window, including resizing and quest-row alignment.
Native scrollbar arrows and dragging stop cleanly when a window closes.
